assets.prompt: Game UI sprite atlas: eight exceptionally readable coarse pixel-art route-map STENCIL SYMBOLS, true transparent background. EXACT 4 columns x 2 rows, equally sized isolated symbols centered in generously padded equal square cells. Landscape 2:1 canvas. THESE ARE FLAT SYMBOLS painted on a survivor's industrial tower exploration chart, NOT miniature buildings, NOT rendered objects, NOT badges or boxed cards. Use ONE flat warm ivory ink color (#d4cfb3), no shading, no gradients, no glow, no outlines, no dirt speckles, no background. Broad chunky square pixel edges, 24x24 logical pixel grid feeling, bold strong different silhouettes readable at 32px. Limit detail and ensure empty negative spaces remain broad. Top row left to right: 1 COMBAT = two crossed short cartridge bullets with pointed tips; 2 ELITE = angular menacing horned sentry mask, 2 large eye holes and pointed chin, no outer shield; 3 BOSS/GATE = tall archway with 3 heavy vertical portcullis bars and small upward arrow above it; 4 SHOP = simple balance scale with two large pans and central coin disk, recognizable trading symbol. Bottom row left to right: 5 WORKSHOP = one large diagonal open-ended wrench, open jaw and square handle hole; 6 SUPPLY = broad closed crate with thick lid and large central clasp, no cross or medical symbol; 7 SIGNAL/EVENT = antenna mast with two pairs of blocky radio wave arcs; 8 BYPASS = a bent route arrow curving around a central solid vertical obstacle, clear gap around obstacle, points upward. All exactly same ivory color, optically matched sizes, zero lettering, zero numerals, zero connecting lines between cells. Strong elegant pictograms for a serious atmospheric pixel game, mechanically precise broad shapes.
